name: OpenVibe.Run
description: OpenVibe.Run will run code, tools and AI agent tasks in sandboxes: quick jobs in WebAssembly, full environments in small virtual machines, with queued jobs, live output, and files through OpenVibe.Download. A free, limited tier for everyone, and the engine the rest of the network uses to get work done.

pillars.title: Sandboxed
pillars.text: Every run is isolated, budgeted and stoppable.

pillars.title: Async & streaming
pillars.text: Queue work, watch its output live, get the result.

pillars.title: Agent tasks
pillars.text: Let AI tools run steps for you, safely.

pillars.title: For every site
pillars.text: The same engine behind tools, pictures, video and chat.
